_note: Per-layer fits.  log10PF per layer = D*v**-alpha + C + B*v**beta   (B/beta absent where no impaction term is used);  dp per layer = k_layer*v.  v in cm/s, dp in Pa, t_layer in cm.  alpha is capped at 2/3 (diffusion), beta at 1.0 (impaction). See RESULTS.md for the fit-selection rules.
